### Mustard Seeds and The Greatness of God
Author: R.C. Sproul
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/mustard-seeds-the-greatness-god
Passage: Mark 4:30-32
Points:
- Jesus' description of the mustard seed employs common Jewish hyperbole for something superlatively tiny rather than a botanical error.
- The central lesson highlights the greatness of God rather than the seed itself.
- God uses our smallest words and humblest deeds of service to build an enduring kingdom.
- The kingdom advances through faithful obedience to God's Word and Spirit instead of flash or worldly fanfare.

### Mustard Seed and Leaven
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/learn/devotionals/mustard-seed-and-leaven
Passage: Matthew 13:31-33
Points:
- Jesus used ordinary agricultural and household images to reveal spiritual truths to common people.
- The Messiah inaugurated a kingdom that grows over a long period before its final consummation.
- God's kingdom starts in a small, hidden manner but eventually expands to undeniable greatness.
- Despite present darkness and affliction, God's work advances silently and irresistibly across the world.
